title: Ingress filter
description: With ingress filtering on the backbone, triangle-routed replies from the MN are dropped. Enabling reverse tunneling fixes it.

steps.note: Backbone now drops packets with a topologically wrong source
MN replies (source 10.1.0.50 leaving 10.2.0.0/24) are dropped. Watch the CN reply counter stay flat.
T flag on: FA-1 tunnels replies to the HA, outer source 10.2.0.1
Replies reach the CN again through the home agent
